config.hypothesis: Independent biological group count, not nucleus count, is the dominant data bottleneck.
config.design: matched total nuclei/class; low-diversity=2 source groups/class versus high-diversity=8 groups/class; 40 nuclei/class where feasible; fixed classifier protocol
config.primary: group-disjoint test macro-F1 and per-class AUPRC
config.success: high-diversity arm wins consistently at the fixed matched sample count across the preregistered seeds 17/29/43; the density arm distinguishes additional groups from additional same-group nuclei
config.failure: if matched high-diversity does not improve, pure pseudo-replication becomes less likely
config.checkpoint_policy: use the matching Prompt-6 Gaussian checkpoint for each seed
